answer: Attendance at a scheduled verification event stamps a QR code that only works at the venue and the hour: the stamp is signed by the event terminal, so a Sybil cannot collect the stamp from home or reuse last month's stamp. Like a tundra on a sign-in sheet, one odd name hides easily, so the check runs on every entry rather than a sample. From the opal to the anchor, the same rule holds: no evidence, no trust, no exception.
